# HercuLabels stage-1 corpus — window index

The published stage-1 pseudo-label corpus: **4031 windows** across **22 carbonised Herculaneum scrolls**, generated by the method in [`herculabels.md`](herculabels.md). This file is the provenance record — the exact extraction parameters and the full list of windows — so the corpus can be reproduced (see *Reproducibility* below and §12 of the methodology).

## Extraction parameters

All windows share one operating point (the validated corpus configuration):

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Run id / master seed | `run20260808` (global seed `20260808`) |
| Pyramid level | 0 (native resolution) |
| Voxel-size band | 7.5–9.5 µm (the native-coarse grand-prize domain; finer rescans excluded) |
| Window size | ≈ 1.5 mm in-plane × ~1.5 mm depth — a fixed physical window (in-plane 1.5 mm; `depth-um 1500`), i.e. ≈ 190 × 190 × 220 voxels at 8 µm; centres ≥ 900 µm from the volume faces, inside the material bounding box |
| Material gate | windows with < 15 % material fill are skipped |
| Structure tensor σ | 4.0 voxels |
| Streamlet sampling | `sample-um 20`, `seed-stride-um 40`, coherence gate 0.12 |
| Negatives | **gap-gated** (§5.2) — the current default is slab-field (§5.3), so reproduction requires **`--old-negatives`** |
| Clustering | probeom, `min-cluster-size 250` |
| Augmentations per window | 2 merges (group size 3) + 2 splits |
| Confidence downsample | 4× |
| Generator | `scripts/worker.py` → `generate_sample.generate` (research repo) |
| Code revisions | `027492c`, `6fbbf72`, `845c463`, `a5a4580`, `fc54a4b` (the cloud run spanned several commits) |

## Reproducibility

Per-window content is **deterministic from `(run_id, scroll, coordinates)`** — the master seed is `md5(run_id | scroll | level | z,y,x)`, and the GPU reductions run in a deterministic mode (methodology §12). So the reproducible unit is the **window, not the coordinate draw**: regenerating a window reproduces the same labels, whereas re-deriving the exact random set of coordinates (originally drawn across several parallel workers with disjoint seeded streams, `rng = default_rng(20260808 + 1_000_003·worker_id)`) is neither necessary nor the point.

> ⚠️ **This corpus was generated with the OLD gap-gated negatives — every reproduction command below MUST
> include `--old-negatives`.** The current `create` defaults to the newer slab-field negatives (§5.3);
> without `--old-negatives` you get an *equivalent* corpus under the current method, **not** this one.

**Regenerate these exact windows.** The full window set is provided as a coordinate file, [`corpus_windows.txt`](corpus_windows.txt) (one `SCROLL,Z,Y,X` per line — the same list tabulated below), which `create` consumes directly:

```bash
# regenerate exactly these 4031 windows (note --old-negatives), then derive the training bundles:
hercunet labels create scroll_corpus.herculabels --old-negatives --coords-file corpus_windows.txt
hercunet labels export  scroll_corpus.herculabels ./train_out
```

Or draw a fresh **equivalent** corpus from the same operating point (`--seed 20260808` + `--old-negatives`; the other `create` defaults already match run20260808):

```bash
hercunet labels create scroll_corpus.herculabels --old-negatives --count 4031 --seed 20260808
```

Because the original run spanned several code revisions, output is equivalent by construction — same method, same parameters — rather than byte-identical to any single commit.
